settings.question_1: What types of film do you develop?
settings.answer_1: We process C41 colour negative, black & white, and ECN-2 cine film, in both 35mm and 120 formats.
settings.question_2: How fast will my film be ready?
settings.answer_2:
• C41: Same Day – next business day
  • B&W: 1-3 business days
  • ECN-2: 1-3 business days*

'Business Days’ are Monday to Saturday
Turnaround times are using our default Noritsu scanner (add 2 days for other scanners)

* For ECN-2 films containing Remjet: Allow up to 7 days
settings.question_3: What development chemicals do you use?
settings.answer_3: For C41 colour development we use only genuine Kodak chemicals. For black and white, we use Kodak XTol developer.
settings.question_4: Do you push or pull film?
settings.answer_4: We offer push/pull for black & white (up to 3 stops, no extra charge) and C41 ($5 per stop).
settings.answer_5: Yes. If it’s more than 12 months out of date, please let us know when ordering.

settings.question_1: Which scan size should I choose?
settings.answer_1:
• Socials. For sharing online and small 6 x 4 prints
  • Standard (Large). Our most popular, a high-resolution all-rounder for print sizes up to A3.
  • Pro (XL). For extra large prints up to A2, or lots of editing flexibility
settings.question_2: How do I get my scans?
settings.answer_2: We’ll email you a download link when they’re ready. Your scans stay online for 4 weeks.
settings.question_3: Do I need to pick a particular scanner or settings?
settings.answer_3: Not unless you want to! Our standard (Noritsu) scans are high resolution and look fantastic with our standard lab settings.
settings.answer_4: By default, we cut and sleeve 35mm negatives in strips of 6, then safely store them for 3 months for collection. You can also request uncut negatives, or have them mailed back.
settings.question_5: Do you re-scan film that’s already developed?
settings.answer_5: Yes. We’ll re-scan to our high standards. Please note dust removal results depend on how the negatives have been stored.
settings.question_6: What if my roll comes out blank?
settings.answer_6: Occasionally, camera malfunction can result in blank rolls. If that happens, don’t worry - we’ll credit you the scanning portion of your payment.

settings.question_1: Where can I drop off or mail my film?
settings.answer_1:
• Bring it to our Surry Hills lab (above Title Bookstore)
  • Use our 24/7 street-level dropbox
  • Use our Lab-door dropbox (7 days, 11 am – 5:30 pm)
  • Use one of our other drop-off boxes around Sydney
  • Or mail it to us from anywhere in Australia
settings.answer_3: Nationwide negative packing & shipping is $13 with Australia Post.
settings.question_4: Is it safe to use drop drop boxes?
settings.answer_4:
We take every precaution, and most of our drop locations are indoors. For outside boxes, like any mail-type box, there’s always a small risk of theft or weather damage.

Our drop-off boxes are weather-resistant, but we also recommend placing your film in a sealable plastic bag before putting in the envelope
